title: Even a's or ends in b: a union
notes: A counts a's (p0 when the count is even) and B remembers whether the last symbol was b (q1). All four pairs turn up, and three of them accept: for a union, a pair accepts when either half does. Only (p1, q0), an odd count that does not end in b, rejects.
ops: start p0; accept p0; p0 a -> p1; p1 a -> p0; p0 b -> p0; p1 b -> p1 | start q0; accept q1; q0 a -> q0; q0 b -> q1; q1 a -> q0; q1 b -> q1
